verdict.rationale: The changelog shows feature-by-feature updates (e.g. lobe-chat-docs-1, lobe-chat-docs-29, lobe-chat-docs-47) and a 'Migrate from Local Database' doc exists, implying some versioned release notes and migration support, but there's no explicit rollback/repair procedure, no breaking-change or upgrade-safety guidance for self-hosters. Missing for 10: documented rollback/repair path when an update breaks, explicit migration notes tied to Docker Compose self-hosted upgrades, and independent confirmation of safe-update practices.
